    Finite category algebras under object-bijective linear equivalence #

    A linear equivalence of finite categories need not preserve the chosen category algebra: an equivalent category may contain duplicate isomorphic objects, and the biproduct of all representables then changes. This file records the exact replacement. When the forward functor is literally bijective on objects, precomposition identifies corresponding representables, the two finite projective generators, and hence their endomorphism algebras.
